organization_note: The Terms of Service, last updated August 2025, give Engineered Arts Limited at E1-E3 Church View Business Park, Bickland Water Road, Falmouth, TR11 4FZ, United Kingdom, with a VAT and a registration number, and say the terms are governed by the laws of the United Kingdom, so the headquarters is the United Kingdom on the entity's address rather than on the governing-law clause. The home page describes it as a company that "designs and builds embodied AI social humanoids along with an integrated robot management software suite". It is an AI company rather than a hardware vendor that buys its intelligence because its pages say every Ameca runs on its Tritium software suite, which includes the Tritium AI service. It is recorded on the reviewed robot engineered-arts-ameca rather than on a release because the catalog reviews no model release of its own: Tritium AI integrates third-party services, which are not releases of Engineered Arts. No parent organization is recorded. Its site names no frontier-safety or scaling framework, so the field is omitted.
